title: Workers and non-workers in India, 2001
body: Table 4.5: Population of India according to workers and non-workers by gender and location, 2001 (crore). Rural: Male - main workers 17, marginal 3, total workers 20, non-workers 18, total 38; Female - main 6, marginal 5, total workers 11, non-workers 25, total 36; Total - main 23, marginal 8, total workers 31, non-workers 43, total 74. Urban: Male - main 7, marginal 1, total workers 8, non-workers 7, total 15; Female - main 1, marginal 0, total workers 1, non-workers 12, total 13; Total - main 8, marginal 1, total workers 9, non-workers 19, total 28. All: total workers 40 (main 31, marginal 9), non-workers 62, population 102. Source: Census of India 2001. Note: Figures are rounded to nearest crore.

title: India's exports and imports over time
body: An economics student draws an arithmetic line graph of India's exports and imports (Rs in 100 crores) with years on the x-axis. Selected values: 1993-94 exports 698, imports 731; 1997-98 exports 1301, imports 1542; 2001-02 exports 2090, imports 2452; 2005-06 exports 4564, imports 6604; 2009-10 exports 8455, imports 13637; 2013-14 exports 19050, imports 27154. Source: DGCI&S, Kolkata. The student wants to describe the trend shown by the two lines and the gap between them.
